Video-MME: The First-Ever Comprehensive Evaluation Benchmark of Multi-modal LLMs in Video Analysis. arXiv preprint arXiv:2405.21075.
creator: Chaoyou Fu, Yuhan Dai, Yongdong Luo, Lei Li, Shuhuai Ren, Renrui Zhang, Zihan Wang, Chenyu Zhou, Yunhang Shen, Mengdan Zhang, Peixian Chen, Yanwei Li, Shaohui Lin, Sirui Zhao, Ke Li, Tong Xu, Xiawu Zheng, Enhong Chen, Caifeng Shan, Ran He, Xing Sun
description: A comprehensive, full-spectrum multi-modal evaluation benchmark of MLLMs in video analysis, featuring 900 videos across 6 visual domains and 30 subfields with varying durations and multi-modal inputs (subtitles and audio).
name: Video-MME
rai:annotatorDemographics: Annotators with strong English proficiency and extensive research experience in vision-language learning.
rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Each QA pair undergoes examination by a different annotator to verify clear language expression, answerability, and logical consistency. Text-only questions are provided to Gemini 1.5 Pro to filter out QA pairs answerable without video content.
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Annotators thoroughly view the entire video, then iteratively create three relevant questions with four candidate options. A different annotator reviews each QA pair. Gemini 1.5 Pro is used to filter out questions answerable from text alone.
rai:dataCollection: Raw videos are sourced from YouTube across 6 key domains and 30 fine-grained categories, with varying duration lengths (short, medium, long). Corresponding meta-information such as subtitles and audios are also obtained.
rai:dataCollectionRawData: Raw videos from YouTube, along with corresponding meta-information such as subtitles (if provided) and audios.
rai:dataUseCases: Evaluating the compositional video understanding capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), including temporal understanding and multi-modal input processing.
rai:machineAnnotationTools: Gemini 1.5 Pro (used to filter out QA pairs that can be answered solely based on textual questions)
